task.title: To view or edit a segment condition

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the More icon () and select Segment.
Select the Segment Conditional from the segments list in the Segments pane.
Click the Settings icon () icon next to the segment name. This opens the Segment Settings page. where the Segment Type is set to Conditional for that segment.
To edit the conditional, click the Edit icon () icon next to Condition.

info.p: At the time of agreement generation, if your conditional's value evaluates to true, the associated segment is shown in the agreement document.
